message.content: Summing 50 tracks takes 2 s. Is the haversine the slow part?

aiTitle: Speed up distance with a haversine lookup table

content.text:
No. A profile shows 87% of the time in XML parsing and 4% in `distance_km`.

| Part | Share |
|---|---:|
| roxmltree parsing | 87% |
| reading files | 8% |
| distance_km | 4% |

A lookup table wouldn't help. Parsing the 50 files on four threads with `std::thread::scope` brings it to 0.6 s.
